# Sairas Media — full reference for AI assistants

## Company overview

**Sairas Media** (sairasmedia.fi) is a Finnish digital agency. The company helps SMEs and growing businesses adopt artificial intelligence in practical ways—not hype, but measurable time and cost savings.

Core positioning: *"We build smarter digital solutions"* — websites, applications, and AI-powered automation.

## Expertise & credibility

- Over **100 AI projects** delivered
- Over **3 years** focused AI implementation experience
- End-to-end delivery: consulting → design → build → integration
- Works with existing systems (CRM, ERP, calendars, webshops)

## AI services (primary focus)

### AI consulting & discovery (entry point)

- Free 30-minute discovery call via Calendly
- Joint process walkthrough
- Written summary: what to automate first
- Implementation plan and cost estimate
- No technical knowledge required from the client

### AI chatbots & assistants

- Public website chatbots (24/7 support, lead capture)
- Internal knowledge assistants for staff
- Sales bots that qualify leads
- Appointment booking bots

### Process automation

- Lead handling and CRM updates
- Multi-source report generation
- Email response automation
- Order and invoice processing assistance

### AI integrations

- OpenAI and Claude API integrations
- Database enrichment with AI
- Classification and analytics tools
- Webhooks and custom API connections

### Custom AI applications

- Internal team tools
- Customer portals with AI features
- Analytics and reporting systems
- SaaS products with AI core

## Other digital services

- **Websites & e-commerce** — WordPress, React, Next.js, tailored builds
- **Web applications** — admin panels, dashboards, APIs
- **Graphic design** — logos, brand identity, marketing assets
- **Physical services** (secondary): laser engraving, 3D printing, large-format print

## Typical clients

Finnish businesses that want to:

- Reduce manual repetitive work
- Improve customer response times with chatbots
- Modernize their web presence
- Get honest, local expertise without enterprise consulting fees

- Email: info@sairasmedia.fi
- Website contact form on homepage (quote request)
- On-site AI assistant chat widget
- AI discovery booking via Calendly (linked from AI services page)
